name: slack
description: Slack (channel@1 bot over Socket Mode with Block Kit cards, identity-source@1 Sign in with Slack, directory@1)

steps.en: Open https://api.slack.com/apps, choose Create New App → From a manifest, pick your workspace and paste the app manifest below. It registers the bot scopes, the events and the slash commands `/new`, `/env` and `/capybara` the plugin needs.
steps.zh: 打开 https://api.slack.com/apps，选择 Create New App → From a manifest，选中工作区，粘贴下面的应用 manifest。它会登记插件需要的机器人权限、事件以及斜杠命令 `/new`、`/env`、`/capybara`。

steps.en: Under Basic Information → App-Level Tokens choose Generate Token and Scopes, add the scope `connections:write` and copy the `xapp-…` token into the App-level token field. Socket Mode needs no public URL.
steps.zh: 在 Basic Information → App-Level Tokens 选择 Generate Token and Scopes，添加权限 `connections:write`，把 `xapp-…` 令牌填进「应用令牌」。Socket Mode 不需要公网地址。

steps.en: Slack checks the Request URL {{webhookUrl}} when you create the app or save Event Subscriptions: the connection must exist first, and Capybara answers the check. If Slack reports it unverified, save the channel connection, then retry under Event Subscriptions.
steps.zh: 创建应用或保存 Event Subscriptions 时，Slack 会校验 Request URL {{webhookUrl}}：渠道连接要先存在，由 Capybara 应答校验。若 Slack 提示未通过，先保存渠道连接，再到 Event Subscriptions 重试。

steps.en: Choose Install App → Install to Workspace and copy the Bot User OAuth Token (`xoxb-…`) into the Bot token field.
steps.zh: 选择 Install App → Install to Workspace，把 Bot User OAuth Token（`xoxb-…`）填进「机器人令牌」。

steps.en: Copy Basic Information → App Credentials → Signing Secret into the Signing secret field: every webhook request is verified with it, and without it every request is refused.
steps.zh: 把 Basic Information → App Credentials → Signing Secret 填进「签名密钥」：每个 webhook 请求都用它校验，不填则全部拒绝。

steps.en: The manifest's redirect URL {{signInCallbackUrl}} is for Sign in with Slack; it needs `http.publicUrl` set on the deployment. Without it, remove the redirect URL or ask your super admin to set it.
steps.zh: manifest 里的重定向地址 {{signInCallbackUrl}} 用于 Slack 登录，需要部署设置 `http.publicUrl`。未设置时，删掉该重定向地址，或请超级管理员设置。
